name: Declan Mwangi-Kowalczyk
description: One of the earliest neural-feed stars to achieve cross-tier recognition, Declan Mwangi-Kowalczyk's career spanned four decades and seventeen Vantablack productions before his death in 2221 from neural degradation attributed to excessive immersion-session hours. His neural signature — described universally as 'the warmth of certainty' — was so beloved that Vantablack licensed it posthumously, continuing to produce content featuring his emotional texture mapped onto other performers. His estate is contesting the posthumous license.
cultural_impact: His death and the subsequent licensing dispute became the catalyst for the first serious legislative discussion of neural performer rights in the Meridian Compact.
story_hooks: A member of his estate has hired a fixer to obtain internal Vantablack documents showing the corporation knew about his neural degradation years before his death.
A performer whose neural signature is being used as the 'carrier' for Mwangi-Kowalczyk's posthumous texture is experiencing psychological breakdown — and wants out.
An underground director claims to have a final, private neural-feed session Mwangi-Kowalczyk recorded before his death — a session that contains information Vantablack needs buried.
related_entities: Tessera Industries Quantum Entanglement Detonator QED-1 'Certainty'
